summary: indie Semiconductor filed an 8-K reporting that its Scottish subsidiary, Ay Dee Kay Ltd., entered into a Purchase Agreement to acquire the CMOS imaging sensor business from ams-OSRAM AG via the acquisition of all shares of ams Sensor Belgium B.V. and related assets. Total consideration is €40M (~$47.1M), comprising €35M cash at closing plus a €5M vendor debt note at 2.5% simple interest payable in 24 months. The acquisition is expected to close in Q3 2026 subject to regulatory approvals. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and any purchase price adjustments.
